name: RemoraHQ - Core
description: RemoraHQ infrastructure shell. Exposes a ping action used by the RemoraHQ UI to verify the plugin channel end-to-end. On server start, verifies required MeshCentral 1.3.1 source anchors and conditional MongoDB delete prerequisites, and dispatches a domain-scoped critical Alert if any cannot be verified. Source markers do not prove execution or endpoint delivery. Subsequent RemoraHQ plugins (Alert State, Auditor, Reports, Terminal Bridge) extend this core.
